batches.subject: docs: preserve architecture and code quality findings
batches.scope: 保留只读审查、失败复现和未实现能力清单。仅增加审查材料。

batches.subject: fix(harness): enforce shared deadlines and complete cancellation
batches.scope: 嵌套/重试共享截止时间；SQL 取消、异步 HTTP 收束、翻译分支 finally 回收、本地 BGE 子进程与准入保护。保留失败、超时、资源回收反例。

batches.subject: docs(agent): define evolution goals, review gates and PV scenario
batches.scope: 统一 141 个任务、八项自审、S0～S5；记录所有者目标/验收限制与首个 PV 资料整理范围、12 个合成开发用例。ADR 的剩余验收契约仍待沟通。

batches.subject: feat(accounting): persist model call receipts and attribute trace fees
batches.scope: 0023 迁移、持久调用回执、Trace/执行/attempt/预留绑定、失败与未知用量保守结算、真实并行账本测试。

batches.subject: feat(budget): share execution limits across nested model calls
batches.scope: 嵌套节点、重试、Ask/Skill/MCP/活动工具继承总 Token/费用/时间池；预算耗尽阻止后续调用，沿用所有者确认的上限推导。

batches.subject: fix(tasks): fence expired attempts and account for replacement workers
batches.scope: 数据库时钟、领取/续租/提交 fence、从领取起计总时限、接管与旧 worker 费用留痕；两 worker 及行锁等待反例。

batches.subject: feat(query): propagate explicit historical context through Ask and Skills
batches.scope: 0024 迁移；Ask/Task/API Schema/OpenAPI、Skill 提示、缓存与诊断 Replay 绑定查询日期/历史意图，保留归档与权限反例。

batches.subject: fix(skills): verify final business judgments against cited evidence
batches.scope: 引用、数值/单位、否定/条件、语义支持四项核验；两类二阶段比较严格解析与失败关闭；五类 Skill、预算、权限反例。

batches.subject: feat(audit): persist complete Task execution evidence and failure traces
batches.scope: Ask/Task 共用审计、内层证据和候选/最终判断、安全与重试材料；正文只入受限加密载荷，无 key 仅元数据；原子提交/回滚。

batches.subject: feat(replay): bind execution artifacts and rendered evidence provenance
batches.scope: 输入、模型实际请求/参数/回复/回执、源工件摘要、渲染哈希及 Unicode 来源区间；原条件缺工件时 409 拒绝，不假称完整恢复。

batches.subject: refactor(architecture): share production composition and enforce import boundaries
batches.scope: application 契约、infrastructure 身份、knowledge 解析/PII/norm-v1、bootstrap 三入口装配与全部导入迁移；AST 边界检查纳入 make check。

batches.subject: feat(feedback): preserve stable source identities across restore and export
batches.scope: 0025 持久事实库 UUID、稳定反馈 namespace/游标、旧来源显式绑定、DR/独立克隆检查；补元数据最小权限清单和受控时钟真实 DB 接管测试。

limits: Engineering review is not independent human review or model-quality acceptance.
PLAN-02, unseen holdout, S2/S3, Task/MCP exact replay and original-condition restoration remain incomplete.
New hosted experiments require separate explicit scope and budget authorization.
Historical records retain committed=false as their original time-specific state.
